label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: Cookie value (user-provided) flows through URL decoding and conditional logic into 'bar'. The guard ((500/42)+num>200) evaluates to true (196+196=392>200), so 'bar' is set to 'param'. User input thus reaches the XSS sink at L104-L110 ('Sensitive value '' + encodeForHTML(new String(input))'). Although ESAPI.encodeForHTML is present, the sink reflects the decoded user input directly into the HTML response, constituting a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User cookie value retrieved and decoded into param; guard ensures param flows to bar.
Sink writes encoded input to response writer; user input reaches HTML output.
